title: Introduction to Reinforcement Learning
overview: 强化学习(RL)是一种范例，即Agent通过与环境互动，获得反馈奖励，优化政策，以在一定时间内最大限度地增加累积奖励[347]，学习做出顺序决定。与监督学习不同(需要标签输入输出对)， RL通过试运行和错误发现最佳行为。

强化学习(RL)是一种范例，即Agent通过与环境互动，获得反馈奖励，优化政策，以在一定时间内最大限度地增加累积奖励[347]，学习做出顺序决定。与监督学习不同(需要标签输入输出对)， RL通过试运行和错误发现最佳行为。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a paradigm where an agent learns to make sequential decisions by interacting with an environment, receiving rewards as feedback, and optimizing its policy to maximize cumulative reward over time [347]. Unlike supervised learning (which requires labeled input-output pairs), RL discovers optimal behavior through trial and error.

强化学习算法可以沿着几个轴进行分类。理解这个分类法有助于选择一个特定问题的正确方法。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Reinforcement learning algorithms can be classified along several axes. Understanding this taxonomy helps select the right approach for a given problem.

blocks.text: 键分类区分模型-无模型对模型-基于模型:
blocks.originalExcerpt: Key Taxonomy Distinctions Model-Free vs Model-Based:

blocks.text: · 模式无拘:直接从经验中学习政策或价值功能。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Model-Free: Learn policy or value function directly from experience. No knowledge of

blocks.text: 语言动态对于模型来说是难以解决的。
blocks.originalExcerpt: environment dynamics. Most practical for LLMs (language dynamics are intractable to model).

blocks.text: · 基于模型:学习或使用环境过渡模型P(s ' |s， a)，可以提前规划。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Model-Based: Learn or use a model of environment transitions P (s′ |s, a). Can plan ahead.

blocks.text: 样本效率更高，但需要准确的模型。
blocks.originalExcerpt: More sample-efficient but requires accurate model.

blocks.text: 基于价值与基于政策:
blocks.originalExcerpt: Value-Based vs Policy-Based:

blocks.text: • 基于价值:学习Q(s， a)或V(s)，得出政策作为最大Q(s， a)的参数。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Value-Based: Learn Q(s, a) or V (s), derive policy as arg maxa Q(s, a). Works well for

blocks.text: 离散，小的动作空间(如Atari)。具有连续/大动作空间的奋斗。
blocks.originalExcerpt: discrete, small action spaces (e.g., Atari). Struggles with continuous/large action spaces.

blocks.text: • Policy-Based 方法：直接参数化并优化策略 πθ(a|s)，更自然地适用于连续或高维动作空间。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Policy-Based: Directly parameterize and optimize πθ (a|s). Natural for continuous/high-

blocks.text: 维元动作空间。 必需的 LLMs( vocabulary = 32K– 128K 动作)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: dimensional action spaces. Essential for LLMs (vocabulary = 32K–128K actions).

blocks.text: • 演员-批评:将两者结合起来——政策(行动者)提议行动、价值功能(批评)
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Actor-Critic: Combine both — policy (actor) proposes actions, value function (critic)

blocks.text: 评估它们。
blocks.originalExcerpt: evaluates them. PPO for LLMs is actor-critic.

blocks.text: 政策与非政策:
blocks.originalExcerpt: On-Policy vs Off-Policy:

blocks.text: • 政策上:学习现行政策产生的数据。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • On-Policy: Learn from data generated by the current policy. Must regenerate data after

blocks.text: 实例:REINFORCE、PPO、A2C。比较稳定但比较不高效的样本。
blocks.originalExcerpt: each update. Examples: REINFORCE, PPO, A2C. More stable but less sample-efficient.

blocks.text: • 非政策:从任何政策(包括旧版本或其他Agent)产生的数据中学习。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Off-Policy: Learn from data generated by any policy (including old versions or other agents).

blocks.text: 可以重复过去的经验，例如:Q-学习、DQN、SAC。样本效率更高，但更难稳定。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Can reuse past experience. Examples: Q-Learning, DQN, SAC. More sample-efficient but harder to stabilize.

TD学习[346] 靴子——它利用其他值估计来更新值估计，而不用等待整集结束。
blocks.originalExcerpt: TD learning [346] bootstraps — it updates value estimates using other value estimates, without waiting for the full episode to end.

sections.enTitle: Understanding TD Error: “Surprise” as a Learning Signal
sections.zhTitle: 理解 TD 错误: “ 突起” 是一个学习信号

blocks.title: 编者阅读提示
blocks.text: 阅读 §3.4.1「理解 TD 错误: “ 突起” 是一个学习信号」 时，把每个 failure mode 拆成触发条件、可观测信号、影响范围、缓解措施和剩余风险。原书给出的警告不是附录信息，而是决定系统是否能进入生产环境的设计约束。
TD错误衡量Agent对未来奖励的当前估计与采取一步后更新的估计数之间的差异。简言之，这是Agent对报酬的当前估计与新估计之间的差别。
blocks.originalExcerpt: TD error measures the discrepancy between an agent’s current estimate of future reward and a newly updated estimate after taking one step. Put simply, it is the difference between what the

blocks.text: 探险家认为会发生什么，以及接下来会发生什么。 它代表着探险家的“惊奇 ”。 探险家:驾驶自觉的想象中你正在开车回家，预计开车需要30分钟。
blocks.originalExcerpt: agent thought would happen and what actually happened plus what it expects next. It represents the agent’s “surprise.” Intuition: The Driving Analogy Imagine you are driving home and expect the drive to take 30 minutes.

blocks.text: • 预测:共计30分钟。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • The prediction: 30 minutes total.

blocks.text: • 现实转变:十分钟后，你撞上了意想不到的公路建设。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • The reality shift: After 10 minutes, you hit unexpected road construction. Your GPS

blocks.text: 更新，说你现在还有35分钟
blocks.originalExcerpt: updates, saying you now have 35 minutes left.

blocks.text: • TD错误:预计时间总数现在为45分钟(10天+35天)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • The TD Error: Total expected time is now 45 minutes (10 elapsed + 35 remaining). The

blocks.text: 新估计(45分钟)和旧估计(30分钟)之间的差值是+15分钟TD错误。您下次使用这个“突兀”来改变您的路线。
blocks.originalExcerpt: difference between new estimate (45 min) and old estimate (30 min) is a +15 minute TD error. You use this “surprise” to change your route next time.

blocks.text: 积极的TD错误意味着结果比预期的好 – 提升了这个状态的价值。
blocks.originalExcerpt: A positive TD error means the outcome was better than expected → boost this state’s value.

blocks.text: 负的TD错误意味着它比预期的还要糟糕 – 降低这个状态的值。
blocks.originalExcerpt: A negative TD error means it was worse than expected → lower this state’s value.

Agent调整其值函数，将TD错误驱动为零:
blocks.originalExcerpt: The agent adjusts its value function to drive TD error toward zero:
V (St ) ← V (St ) + α · δt (3.11)

blocks.text: • 如果 t > 0:结果比预测的好 增加 V(St)，那么Agent寻求这种状态。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • If δt > 0: outcome was better than predicted → increase V (St ) so the agent seeks this state.

blocks.text: • 如果 < 0.:结果比预测的坏
blocks.originalExcerpt: • If δt < 0: outcome was worse than predicted → decrease V (St ) so the agent avoids this state.

blocks.text: • 如果 = 0:预测是完美的——不需要更新(汇合)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • If δt = 0: prediction was perfect → no update needed (convergence).

在监督学习中，偏差和差异来自结构模型假设。在通过GAE强化学习中，它们来自你对一个有缺陷模型的信任程度，以及对一个混乱环境的信任程度:
blocks.originalExcerpt: In supervised learning, bias and variance stem from structural model assumptions. In reinforcement learning via GAE, they stem from how much you trust a flawed model versus how much you trust a chaotic environment:

blocks.text: • 双子(系统错位):当估计者依赖结构斜角时的上升 --
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Bias (Systemic Misalignment): Arises when the estimator relies on the structural assump-

blocks.text: 数值网络的图解和不完善的预测 Vθ。如果 θ 训练不足或缺乏能力，则基线猜测是系统性错误的。
blocks.originalExcerpt: tions and imperfect predictions of the value network Vθ . If θ is under-trained or lacks capacity, the baseline guesses are systematically wrong.

blocks.text: • 差异(Sample Jitterness):估计者依赖长期、不受约束时出现
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Variance (Sample Jitteriness): Arises when the estimator relies on long, unconstrained

blocks.text: 环境轨迹。 随机过渡、随机种子和政策执行噪音在长的视野中积累，导致经验样本在推出之间剧烈波动。

奖励塑造[265]是一种技术，开发者可以修改或补充环境原始奖励功能。其主要目标是将一种稀少的奖励方案——即Agent只有在完成最后任务后才收到反馈——转变为一种密集的奖励方案，并带有中间反馈信号，以加快趋同。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Reward shaping [265] is a technique where a developer modifies or supplements the environment’s original reward function. Its primary objective is to transform a sparse reward scenario — where the agent receives feedback only upon final task completion — into a dense reward scenario with intermediate feedback signals to accelerate convergence.

blocks.text: 直肠重塑的风险:如果F(s， a， s')是任意设计的， Agent会发现结构漏洞，以最大化辅助信号，而忽略全球目标。例如:一个导航人员因到达中间地标而得到奖励，可能会学会无限期地绕过一个检查站，积累无限的奖励——而从未到达目的地。在法学硕士中:“自信”的模型无论准确与否，都可能学会从“绝对!”开始。
